item.title: Dissection of Flock Safety Camera
item.description:
Flock Safety is marketing its cameras to neighborhood groups and law enforcement with the promise to “reduce crime in your community by up to 70%.” Instead of selling these cameras, it leases them for about $2,500 per month. The cameras can be powered with solar panels and transmit data via a cellular modem so no extra wiring is needed. Note that the version we dissected is an older version and the modem is no longer being sold. Although the cameras capture images that include the license plates of vehicles, they are triggered by a motion detection sensor and will likely capture an image of anything that triggers the motion detector, including people, bicycles, etc.
NimbeLink Skywire LTE cellular modem inside Flock Safety camera
Lantronix SD624 Audio Kit SOM inside Flock Safety camera
Taoglas AP.17E GPS module inside Flock Safety camera
5MP 16mm Fixed M12 1/2 Inch IR Filter Action Camera Lens in Flock Safety camera Here’s the list of component parts that we were able to identify: Cellular: NimbeLink Skywire LTE modem – FCC ID N7NHL7648 P/N: NL-SW-LTE-S7648 (https://nimbelink.com/products/4g-lte-cat-1-att-sierra-wireless/) Battery: PHD Energy lithium ion rechargeable – 10.8V, 19Ah, 205.2Wh SD624 Audio Kit SOM (https://www.lantronix.com/products/open-q-624a-development-kit/) Wifi/bluetooth: LITE ON Technology WCBN3510A 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac 2T2R+BT V4.2LE GPS: Taoglas AP.17E – one stage 17mm active patch antenna Module (https://www.taoglas.com/product/ap-17e-gps-1-stage-active-patch-17mm-2/) Camera lens: 5MP Action Camera Lens 16mm Fixed M12 1/2 Inch IR Filter No gold and just a few dollars worth of copper. https://www.cehrp.org/dissection-of-flock-safety-camera/ #flock #engineering #gold

item.title: GovBrief Today #562
item.description: Federal prosecutors spent the past year investigating Loren Merchan because her father presided over the trial that made Donald Trump a felon. Merchan co-owned a marketing firm until late 2024, and the subpoena that opened the investigation never named a crime. It demanded the firm's private communications with top Democrats, including Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, and Hakeem Jeffries. Trump has always attacked the families of the people he believes crossed him. This time the attack came from a grand jury, and targeting her is what let prosecutors demand everyone else's records. Her lawyers fought back, and after a year the sweeping demand shrank to the emails between Loren and her father, Judge Juan Merchan, and a single $468 payment from the Harris campaign. item.title: Don't mind me, just trying to keep up with the brain damaged rantings of my newest lil' stalker!
item.description: Evidently, a user going by SquaresUnfiltered has become fairly unable to stop thinking about me or the cartoon horses I fancy posting. I'm not sure exactly which cheese crystal in their brain cracked, but they've convinced themselves that I'm running some nefarious cabal of downvoters bent on taking away their precious internet points. So that's a thing, I guess? A quick glance at their comment history paints a fairly unhinged picture that I really don't need to add to. Despite the two of us being in the same political camp, he's spending a worrying amount of his personal time trying to convince users I'm some redhat nutjob. Suffice to say anyone who knows me knows I'm eagerly waiting for the day I get to pop the cork on my "When it happens" brandy. If you've been reading the junk he spits up about me in his rants and noticed I'm not replying, it's because he's got me blocked. Anyway, thought I'd clear that up. The guy's your typical "I haet furriez" screamer who definitely doesn't have e621 in his browser history, isn't mad about getting banned from my Discord, and very definitely isn't defining his personal value from fake internet points. Pretty strong hinges on that closet door, though. :3 (Ayyy, he noticed my post! Bud, if you're reading this and trying to actually work on your mental health, your first step should be getting away from social media. Seriously. You had the right idea a week ago. That isn't a "me wanting to get rid of you suggestion." It's a "you're doomposting for dopamine sips and it's genuinely concerning" observation. Seriously.)
